title: Fill the bar
summary: Note values tapped into the gap of a bar, checked by length.
content:
## Beats in a bar

A bar of 4/4 holds four quarter-note beats. A half note lasts two beats; two eighth notes last one.

## Filling a gap

Any notes that add up to the missing beats fill the gap, unless the question asks for particular ones.

quiz.prompt: This bar is two beats short. Fill it.
quiz.explanation: A half note, two quarter notes, or two eighths and a quarter: each lasts two beats.

quiz.prompt: Fill the bar with one half note.
quiz.explanation: A half note lasts two beats and is written c2. Two quarter notes fill the gap too, but they are two notes.

quiz.prompt: This 3/4 bar is one beat short. Fill it.
quiz.explanation: One beat is a quarter note or two eighth notes.
